description: A dark blue floor-length court dress with a low square neckline, opaque fitted bodice and elbow-length sleeves. Rust-red and pale gold knotwork-like borders decorate the neckline, central bodice and skirt, cuffs and hem. A cream inner skirt and cream fitted sleeve sections appear below the outer layers. Two round metal brooches joined by a small chain fasten the upper bodice. A brown belt with a large decorated round buckle and long studded hanging end secures the waist. A burgundy patterned fringed wrap drapes around the lower arms and down both sides. Brown shoes partly appear at the hem. Exact fibre composition is uncertain.
